parsed.rationale: After upgrading to v2.8, Salesforce sync has been failing with repeated auth token refresh errors, blocking reporting for about 40 enterprise customers; this requires engineering to address the integration/auth failure.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for flagging this. I’m sorry the Salesforce sync has been failing since your v2.8 upgrade and that it’s blocking reporting for ~40 enterprise customers. 

We’ll escalate this for engineering attention as a production integration issue centered on the “auth token refresh” errors. To help the team diagnose quickly, could you please share the following (minimum useful details):
1) The exact auth token refresh error text from the logs (and a timestamp / correlation ID if available), ideally from the first failure after the upgrade.
2) Which Salesforce sync step(s) fail (e.g., token refresh/authenticate vs data fetch/push), and whether it happens for all affected customers or only a subset.
3) Whether this is production-only or also occurring in staging.
4) Any recent changes to Salesforce auth/config during or right after the v2.8 upgrade (credentials/settings/endpoints).

Once we have those, engineering can begin reviewing the issue with higher confidence. We understand your renewal call is tomorrow, so we’ll keep the response moving with the fastest possible next update once the team has the log details.
promised_actions: Escalate to engineering for review of the production Salesforce sync authentication/token refresh failures
Request the minimum log/config details needed to diagnose quickly
safety_notes: We do not promise a specific fix or timeline, and we do not claim root cause.
We acknowledge urgency and indicate engineering escalation without asserting resolution.
We request specific log excerpts and timestamps to avoid inventing error context.
